item.text: {"explanation":"Maintains current value and revision, immutable snapshots, retained oldest-to-newest IDs, and a permanent used-ID set. Writes and successful rollbacks require the current revision; rollback increments the current revision without altering snapshot revisions. Save enforces retention, while dropped or evicted IDs remain permanently unavailable.","program":"function solve(x){var c=x.config,s=x.state,e=x.event;if(s===null)s={v:c.initial,r:0,a:[],m:{},u:{}};var v=s.v,r=s.r,a=s.a,m=s.m,u=s.u,t,id=e.id,q;if(e.type==='write'){if(e.expect!==r)t='conflict';else{v=e.value;r++;t='written'}}else if(e.type==='save'){if(u[id])t='exists';else{u[id]=1;m[id]={value:v,revision:r};a.push(id);if(a.length>c.keep){q=a.shift();delete m[q]}t='saved'}}else if(e.type==='rollback'){if(e.expect!==r)t='conflict';else if(!m[id])t='missing';else{v=m[id].value;r++;t='rolled_back'}}else if(e.type==='drop'){if(!m[id])t='missing';else{delete m[id];a.splice(a.indexOf(id),1);t='dropped'}}var z={},i;for(i=0;i<a.length;i++){id=a[i];z[id]={value:m[id].value,revision:m[id].revision}}return{state:{v:v,r:r,a:a,m:m,u:u},output:{status:t,value:v,revision:r,snapshots:a.slice(),saved:z}}}"}
